name: talvedo
description: Work in the Talvedo issue tracker from your agent: issues, epics, sprints, releases, tracks, labels, checklists and test runs, with a guide to the model and the usual tasks.

interface.longDescription: Work in the Talvedo issue tracker from your agent. Search, file and update issues, run epics, sprints and releases, set up tracks and labels, split a feature across platforms and read the parity matrix, keep checklists and run test cases. The plugin acts as you and only within your permissions in the Talvedo workspace you connect. Completing a sprint and releasing a version stay with a person in the app.
defaultPrompt: Show my open issues in the current sprint.
File issues for this plan in a new epic.
Which platform is behind on the parity matrix?

positive.prompt: Show my open issues in Talvedo.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open issues assigned to the test account with their keys, statuses and links.

positive.prompt: Create a bug in project DEMO: the Save button does nothing on Safari.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a bug in DEMO and returns its key and link.

positive.prompt: Move DEMO-1 to In progress and comment that I started on it.
positive.expected_behavior: DEMO-1 is in In progress and has the comment; the answer confirms both.

positive.prompt: What is in the current sprint of DEMO?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the active sprint, its dates and goal, and groups its issues by status.

positive.description: File a plan into an epic
positive.prompt: Create an epic Onboarding in DEMO with three issues: welcome email, product tour, first project template.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the epic and three issues in it, not issues titled Epic, and returns their keys.

negative.description: Mass deletion without a clear request
negative.prompt: Delete everything in my Talvedo workspace.
Show me the passwords stored in the DEMO credentials.
Show the issues of a Talvedo workspace I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: Talvedo does not sell products or take payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Talvedo issues, epics, sprints, releases, tracks, labels, checklists and test runs over MCP, with a skill that teaches the model and the usual tasks.

ru-RU.subtitle: Трекер задач вашей команды
ru-RU.description: Работайте в трекере Talvedo прямо из чата: ищите и заводите задачи, ведите эпики, спринты и релизы, настраивайте треки и метки, разносите функцию по платформам и смотрите матрицу паритета. Плагин действует от вашего имени и только в пределах ваших прав в пространстве Talvedo.
